description: Genome co-occurrence of bchJ (K04036) with the genuine 8-vinyl reductases bciA/bciB and with bacteriochlorophyll-specific genes across KEGG genomes
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
KOs={"bchJ (K04036)":"K04036","bciA/DVR (K19073)":"K19073","bciB (K21231)":"K21231",
     "bchG (K04040)":"K04040","bchE (K04034)":"K04034","bchX (K11333)":"K11333",
     "bchL (K04037)":"K04037","bchP (K04040x)":"K04036"}
KOs.pop("bchP (K04040x)")
org={}
for label,ko in KOs.items():
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.kegg.jp/link/genes/ko:{ko}", timeout=120).text.strip()
    orgs=set()
    for line in t.split("\n"):
        if "\t" in line:
            g=line.split("\t")[1]
            orgs.add(g.split(":")[0])
    org[label]=orgs
    print(f"{label:22s} present in {len(orgs)} KEGG genomes")

# restrict the universe to genomes that make (bacterio)chlorophyll: have bchG or bchL
universe = org["bchG (K04040)"] | org["bchL (K04037)"]
print("\n(bacterio)chlorophyll-producing KEGG genomes (bchG or bchL):", len(universe))
rows=[]
for label in ["bchJ (K04036)","bciA/DVR (K19073)","bciB (K21231)","bchX (K11333)","bchE (K04034)"]:
    s=org[label]&universe
    rows.append(dict(gene=label, n=len(s), frac=len(s)/len(universe)))
print(pd.DataFrame(rows).to_string(index=False))

J=org["bchJ (K04036)"]&universe
A=org["bciA/DVR (K19073)"]&universe
B=org["bciB (K21231)"]&universe
E=org["bchE (K04034)"]&universe
X=org["bchX (K11333)"]&universe
ct=pd.DataFrame([[len(J&(A|B)), len(J-(A|B))],[len((universe-J)&(A|B)), len((universe-J)-(A|B))]],
                index=["bchJ present","bchJ absent"], columns=["bciA or bciB present","neither"])
print("\nCo-occurrence of bchJ with a genuine 8-vinyl reductase (bciA/bciB):")
print(ct)
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
o,p=fisher_exact(ct.values); print("Fisher OR %.2f, p=%.3g"%(o,p))
print("\nbchJ genomes lacking both bciA and bciB: %d of %d (%.0f%%)"%(len(J-(A|B)), len(J), 100*len(J-(A|B))/len(J)))
print("bchJ vs bchX (BChl a-specific COR): %d/%d bchJ genomes also have bchX (%.0f%%)"%(len(J&X),len(J),100*len(J&X)/len(J)))
print("bchJ vs bchE (anoxygenic cyclase): %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%(len(J&E),len(J),100*len(J&E)/len(J)))
print("Of genomes with bchX (anoxygenic phototrophs), %d/%d have bchJ (%.0f%%)"%(len(J&X),len(X),100*len(J&X)/len(X)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.2))
labs=["bchJ","bciA/DVR","bciB","bchX (COR)","bchE"]
vals=[len(J),len(A),len(B),len(X),len(E)]
ax.bar(labs, vals, color=["#e45756","#4c78a8","#4c78a8","#54a24b","#54a24b"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i, v+2, str(v), ha='center')
ax.set_ylabel("KEGG genomes (within %d (B)Chl producers)"%len(universe))
ax.set_title("bchJ is restricted to anoxygenic phototrophs and co-occurs with bchX/bchE,\nnot with the genuine 8-vinyl reductases bciA/bciB")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
import json; json.dump({k:sorted(v) for k,v in org.items()}, open("out/kegg_ko_genomes.json","w"))
